description: This file defines a class 'FormatWithFluency' implementing the 'ValueFormatter' interface. It provides a method to format an entity value based on a static 'FLUENCIES' array in the 'EmployeeLanguage' class, returning a string representation or null if not found. The class is part of the 'OrangeHRM\\Maintenance\ ormatValue' namespace and appears to be used for formatting language fluency levels in the HRM system.

classes.name: FormatWithFluency
classes.description: A class that implements the ValueFormatter interface to provide formatted string output for employee language fluency levels based on an external static array.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the formatted string representing the fluency level for the given entity value, or null if not defined.
